g.text: Tile: upper field = mass number; symbol; lower field = atomic number; name.
Source classification at room temperature: cyan metals; violet solid nonmetals; yellow gases.
Red outline: liquids; green outline: metalloids.
Groups: alkali metals (1), alkaline earth metals (2), transition metals (middle),
halogens (7/VII), noble gases (0/VIII). Periods I–VII; detached lanthanide/actinide series.
Historical source labels and numeric anomalies retained: Pr 260; Rn 85; Cm 98; ZICN; CAPRANIUM; legacy
Unq/Unp/Unh. Some source upper/lower fields are reversed.
